name: scix-arxiv
description: Local MCP server for NASA SciX/ADS and arXiv: search, read papers by section, LaTeX source, citations, libraries and topic alerts.

scix_api_token.title: SciX API token
scix_api_token.description: Needed for the scix_* tools (arXiv tools work without it). Create one at https://scixplorer.org/user/settings/token

semantic_scholar_api_key.title: Semantic Scholar API key (optional)
semantic_scholar_api_key.description: Raises the rate limit of arxiv_citation_graph; without it Semantic Scholar answers 429 quickly. Request one at https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api#api-key-form
